rules.statement: Bits [1:0] of i_s_axi_awaddr and i_s_axi_araddr must have no effect on any output.

rules.condition: Address word index k with 0 <= k < PARA_NUM_REGS
rules.statement: An address with word index k selects read/write register k.

rules.condition: Address word index is 16 (byte address 0x40 to 0x43)
rules.statement: The address selects the status register.

rules.condition: Address is not a read/write register or status register address, including word indices PARA_NUM_REGS to 15, 17 to 31, or any 1 in bit 7 to PARA_ADDR_W-1
rules.statement: Every other address is unmapped.
Decode compares all address bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2] so no register or status register appears at more than one word index (no aliasing).

rules.condition: Write transaction
rules.statement: A write transaction is decoded from the address taken at its AW transfer.

rules.condition: Read transaction
rules.statement: A read transaction is decoded from the address taken at its AR transfer.

rules.condition: Every cycle after R1 in which no write address is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready shall be 1.

rules.condition: A write address is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready shall be 0.

rules.condition: Every cycle after R1 in which no write data is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_wready shall be 1.

rules.condition: Write data is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_wready shall be 0.

rules.condition: One write transaction
rules.statement: The block takes the AW and W transfers in either order or at the same edge.

rules.condition: Before both AW and W transfers of the transaction are taken
rules.statement: The block shall not answer a write transaction before it has taken both AW and W transfers.

rules.condition: After an AW transfer, until the edge after Eb of that transaction
rules.statement: The block shall take no other AW transfer.

rules.condition: After a W transfer, until the edge after Eb of that transaction
rules.statement: The block shall take no other W transfer.

rules.condition: Write transaction
rules.statement: The strobes and data used are the values of i_s_axi_wstrb and i_s_axi_wdata taken at the W transfer.

rules.condition: Write selects read/write register k, at edge Ec, for each lane i with i_s_axi_wstrb[i]=1
rules.statement: Bits 8i+7..8i of register k take the value of the same bits of the write data taken at Ew.

rules.condition: Write selects read/write register k
rules.statement: Byte lanes of register k whose strobe bit is 0 keep their value.

rules.condition: Write to register k at edge Ec
rules.statement: The written value appears on o_regs[32k+31:32k] from edge Ec, in the cycle starting at Ec.

rules.condition: Write transaction selecting register k
rules.statement: A write shall change no bit of o_regs outside bits 32k+31..32k.

rules.condition: Write transaction
rules.statement: A write changes its register only at its edge Ec and only once.

rules.condition: Write selects the status register
rules.statement: The write shall change no bit of o_regs.

rules.condition: Write to an unmapped address
rules.statement: The write shall change no bit of o_regs.

rules.condition: Write to read/write register k with i_s_axi_wstrb = 4'b0000
rules.statement: The write changes no bit of o_regs and answers OKAY.

rules.condition: Other than edge Ec of a write selecting them or i_rst_n asserted
rules.statement: Bits of o_regs shall not change.

rules.condition: From edge Ec of a write transaction
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 1 in the cycle starting at Ec.

rules.condition: Once o_s_axi_bvalid is 1, until and including the cycle ending at Eb
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid stays 1 and o_s_axi_bresp stays unchanged.

rules.condition: From edge Eb, unless i_rst_n asserted earlier
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 0.

rules.condition: Each write transaction that reaches Ec
rules.statement: The block gives exactly one B transfer per write transaction.

rules.condition: No write transaction is waiting for its B transfer
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bvalid shall be 0.

rules.condition: Write selects a read/write register or the status register
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bresp shall be 2'b00 (OKAY).

rules.condition: Write to an unmapped address
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bresp shall be 2'b10 (SLVERR).

rules.condition: o_s_axi_bvalid is 1
rules.statement: o_s_axi_bresp shall never be 2'b01 or 2'b11.

rules.condition: o_s_axi_bvalid is 0 and i_rst_n is 1
rules.statement: The value of o_s_axi_bresp is unspecified and shall not be checked.

rules.condition: Every cycle after R1 in which no read address is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_arready shall be 1.

rules.condition: A read address is held
rules.statement: o_s_axi_arready shall be 0.

rules.condition: After an AR transfer, until the edge after Er of that transaction
rules.statement: The block shall take no other AR transfer.

rules.condition: From edge Ear of a read transaction
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 1 in the cycle starting at Ear.

rules.condition: Once o_s_axi_rvalid is 1, until and including the cycle ending at Er
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid stays 1 and o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp stay unchanged.

rules.condition: From edge Er, unless i_rst_n asserted earlier
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0.

rules.condition: Each AR transfer
rules.statement: The block gives exactly one R transfer for each AR transfer.

rules.condition: No read transaction is waiting for its R transfer
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0.

rules.condition: Read selects read/write register k
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rdata equals o_regs[32k+31:32k] in the cycle ending at Ear.

rules.condition: Read selects the status register
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rdata equals i_status in the cycle ending at Ear.

rules.condition: i_status changes after Ear during the read in progress
rules.statement: The change shall not alter o_s_axi_rdata.

rules.condition: Read selects a read/write register or the status register
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rresp shall be 2'b00 (OKAY).

rules.condition: Read to an unmapped address
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rdata shall be 32'h0000_0000 and o_s_axi_rresp shall be 2'b10 (SLVERR).

rules.condition: o_s_axi_rvalid is 1
rules.statement: o_s_axi_rresp shall never be 2'b01 or 2'b11.

rules.condition: o_s_axi_rvalid is 0 and i_rst_n is 1
rules.statement: Values of o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp are unspecified and shall not be checked.

rules.condition: Read transaction
rules.statement: A read shall change no bit of o_regs.

rules.condition: A write is held or waiting for its B transfer
rules.statement: AR and R channels work independently of AW, W and B: value and timing of arready, rvalid, rdata, rresp are unchanged, except register value per REQ-CC-003 to 006.

rules.condition: A read is held or waiting for its R transfer
rules.statement: The value and timing of awready, wready, bvalid, bresp and o_regs shall not change.

rules.condition: AR transfer of a read of register k at the same edge as Ec of a write to register k
rules.statement: The read returns the old value of register k before that write.

rules.condition: Ec of a write to register k is before Ear of a read of register k
rules.statement: The read returns the value written, unless another write to k with Ec before Ear came in between.

rules.condition: Ec of a write to register k is after Ear of a read of register k
rules.statement: The write shall not change o_s_axi_rdata of the read.

rules.condition: Read of register k
rules.statement: Read data equals one whole value register k held in the cycle ending at Ear, never a mix of bytes of two values.
